2457-4289-4365-8296.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2946-4446-4871-5670.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
2946-4446-4871-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Cleric
A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-4446-4871-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Relic Vial and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

4613-4687-5168.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Bloom Tender has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-4687-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least [X] colors among permanents you control.
4613-4687-5168.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Bloom Tender using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1417-2466-3249--52.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's last ability by tapping Grimgrin, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Bridge from Below triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

628-7217-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability
Repeat.

4871-5220-5849-6495.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5220-5849-6495.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.
4871-5220-5849-6495.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

4551-7688-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
4551-7688-8089.description:
Activate M.O.D.O.K. by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1479-2841-6158-7892.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Blighted Woodland.
1479-2841-6158-7892.description:
Fetch a land using Blighted Woodland.
When the fetched land enters, Thranduil the Strategist and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Thranduil the Strategist triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

338-1379-2685-3197.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-1379-2685-3197.description:
Gain life in any way.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1912-4866-6822-7426.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1912-4866-6822-7426.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {1} due to Biomancer's Familiar and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3621-6798-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard with haste.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guard token dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.
3621-6798-7282.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can just do step 1 repeatedly.

3817-4050-4605-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Sister Hospitaller and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Sister Hospitaller trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-1780-6753.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve the Burdened Aerialist trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

1251-2033-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1251-2033-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

1525-5751-6504-7010.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1525-5751-6504-7010.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

147-2596-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2596-5231.description:
Cast Living Death by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Living Death.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, and then Thermopod.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Living Death
Resolve the Living Death copy, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, and returning all cards exiled this way to the battlefield under their owner's control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

413-3108-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Grim Poppet enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
413-3108-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

4924-6867-6869.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

2257-4508-5929.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
2257-4508-5929.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Leyline of Transformation, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

440-1339-2034-6752.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-1339-2034-6752.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Well of Lost Dreams triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams trigger, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

4499-4747-4927.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Alena.
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may blink any other creature(s) you control.

277-1479-5700-5701-6517.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-1479-5700-5701-6517.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dragonback Assault trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dragonback Assault trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Dragonback Assault triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

791-3693-6093-6257.notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-6093-6257.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

5011-5147-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Cavalier of Night in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
5011-5147-5326.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

38-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: The Reality Chip attached to any creature you control except Skirk Prospector.
38-5220-5243.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Skirk Prospector on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying {R}.
Repeat.

1806-2604-3002-3263-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {2}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Rest in Peace.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {1}.
Repeat.

914-1316-2179-4404-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Vat of Rebirth has at least two oil counters on it.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1316-2179-4404-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia twice by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist and Corridor Monitor.
Dockside Extortionist and Corridor Monitor dies, triggering Vat of Rebirth twice, putting two oil counters on it.
Resolve both Altar of Dementia abilities, causing target player to mill cards equal to Dockside Extortionist's and Corridor Monitor's power.
Activate Vat of Rebirth by paying {2}{B}, tapping it and removing four oil counters from it, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Kurkesh triggers, choose to pay {R} to copy Vat of Rebirth's ability, targeting Corridor Monitor.
Resolve the copy of Vat of Rebirth's ability, returning Corridor Monitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, untapping Vat of Rebirth.
Resolve the original Vat of Rebirth ability, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Vat of Rebirth triggers twice, putting two oil counters on it.
Repeat.

224-872-5033.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-872-5033.description:
Activate Scaled Herbalist by tapping it, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Scaled Herbalist.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from your battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

933-1190-2104.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Biblioplex Assistant.
Biblioplex Assistant enters the battlefield, putting Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard on top of your library.
Move to your next turn.
Draw Temporal Manipulation.
Repeat.

3284-3389-3809.description:
Cast Flickering Ward for {W}, targeting Goldspan Dragon.
Goldspan Dragon triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}.
Korvold triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and drawing a card.
Activate Flickering Ward for {W}, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
